statements.impact_statement: Trivy reports mcp 1.28.1 in this exact image; the fixed release line begins at 1.30.0. The advisory concerns streamable HTTP server session memory exhaustion; this image is consumed over stdio, but no reachability assessment is used to suppress the finding.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade the locked mcp dependency to a compatible fixed release, rerun tests and the authenticated image smoke, then rebuild and issue a new image-specific assessment. This statement is not a waiver.
